image_description: A close-up shot of a white toilet paper roll mounted on a metallic, curved holder against a beige wall. The toilet paper features a distinct embossed texture and has black, handwritten-style text printed or drawn directly onto the outer layers of the roll.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the toilet paper roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the roll is nonsensical and illegible ('gibberish'). While stylized handwriting can be hard to read, the characters lack consistent structure, spacing, and linguistic logic, typical of AI models struggling to render coherent text on curved surfaces.

The black ink/text appears slightly 'painted on' rather than absorbed into the fibrous texture. There is a slight lack of interaction between the ink and the embossed peaks/valleys of the paper texture, making it look superficially overlaid.
